description: Small labelled element with Soft, Filled, and Outlined variants, an optional pressed toggle variant (a native <button aria-pressed> via Pressed/PressedChanged with trailing ChildContent for a count), optional icon, removable close button, clickable/selectable states, custom color via CSS variable, and two sizes.

parameters.name: Pressed
parameters.description: Pressed state of the TOGGLE variant. null (the default) keeps the legacy <span> chip; any value renders a NATIVE <button type="button" aria-pressed> with the same classes plus tm-chip--pressed. Per docs/keyboard-activation-convention.md the button activates natively - the component adds NO Enter/Space emulation, so a press raises the event exactly once. The value is host-owned: the toggle raises PressedChanged with the flipped value and never mutates the parameter (enable @bind-Pressed). Pressed and Clickable/OnClick are exclusive paths.

parameters.name: PressedChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user presses a pressed chip with the flipped value; enables @bind-Pressed.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Optional trailing content (e.g. a count badge) rendered after the label. It is part of the chip's visible content and therefore of its accessible name - do NOT aria-hide it.

examples.title: Clickable chip with icon and custom color
examples.code:
<TmChip Label="Priority: High"
        Icon="flag"
        Color="#ef4444"
        Variant="ChipVariant.Filled"
        Clickable="true"
        Selected="@isSelected"
        OnClick="ToggleSelection" />
